User.title: User
User.description: A user of the DuesMaster system.

uid.description: The unique identifier for the user.

role.description: The user's role in the system.

groupId.description: The ID of the group the user belongs to (if applicable).

Group.title: Group
Group.description: An organized group (Church, Alumni, Club, etc.) that manages dues.

id.description: The unique identifier for the group.

adminUid.description: The UID of the Group Admin.

duesTarget.description: The target dues amount for the period (in GH₵).

announcements.description: A list of announcements for the group.

Payment.title: Payment
Payment.description: A record of a dues payment by a member.

id.description: The unique identifier for the payment.

memberUid.description: The UID of the member who made the payment.

groupId.description: The ID of the group the payment belongs to.

date.description: The date and time of the payment.

reference.description: A reference number for the payment.

PaymentNotification.title: PaymentNotification
PaymentNotification.description: A notification sent by a member to an admin to verify a payment.

id.description: The unique identifier for the notification.

memberUid.description: The UID of the member sending the notification.

amount.description: The amount claimed to have been paid.

reference.description: A reference number or transaction ID.

screenshotUrl.description: A URL to a screenshot of the payment receipt.

status.description: The status of the verification request.

ActivityLog.title: ActivityLog
ActivityLog.description: A log of actions performed by admins.

id.description: The unique identifier for the log entry.

adminUid.description: The UID of the admin who performed the action.

action.description: A description of the action performed.

Invitation.title: Invitation
Invitation.description: An invitation sent to a potential member or admin.

id.description: The unique identifier for the invitation.

invitedBy.description: The UID of the person who sent the invite.

/groups/{groupId}/activity_logs/{logId}.description: Admin activity logs for a group.
